## Important split: two Android translate stacks

`feature-translate` (19 Kotlin files) is **not** the same as the modern cloud AI translate used for glasses/one-key/face-to-face.

| Stack | Where | Network | Typical device |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Legacy** | `feature-translate` | Baidu HTTP + Ali ASR | Watch “百度翻译” |
| **Modern cloud** | `module-ai`, `feature-jacket`, iOS `WK*` managers | SSE chunked upload + SSE text stream | Glasses, jacket, sound, back-clip, watch |

Flutter `feature_interpretation` is **同声传译** (continuous WebSocket), not face-to-face or one-key — but it shares the same cloud ASR/TTS backend family.

## Session flows

### Face-to-face (dual alternating speaker)

**Modern path (glasses/jacket/back-clip — cloud SSE)**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant App
  participant Cloud as AI Gateway SSE
  participant BLE as Device 0x26 optional

  User->>App: Hold left or right speak button
  App->>App: startRecord (60s timeout)
  App->>Cloud: POST chunked PCM to function/speechRecognition
  Cloud-->>App: SSE dataType=1 ASR text
  App->>App: Show source bubble (left/right column)
  Cloud-->>App: SSE dataType=2 translation
  App->>App: Update target bubble
  Cloud-->>App: SSE dataType=3 TTS PCM chunks
  App->>App: Play TTS / cache PCM for replay
```

- **Android**: `FaceTransHelper` — left press uses `(leftLang → rightLang)`, right press reverses; `ASRStreamPort` with `transFlag=true`, `ttsFlag=true`.
- **iOS**: `WKAIFTFTranslatedViewModel` — `ruleType = face2faceTranslate`; `WKShortAudioRecordStreamManager` with `transFlag=true`, `ttsFlag=true`.
- **UI model**: chat list with `isLeft` flag; language swap exchanges `from`/`to`.
- **No continuous session** — each utterance is an independent record → upload → SSE response cycle.

**Legacy path (`feature-translate` face mode)**

`HomeRecordHelper` state machine:
`OFF → RECORDING → (move outside = CANCEL) → CONVERT → OFF | FAIL`

On release: `RecordAudioUtil` → `TtsService.startRecognition` (Ali ASR) → `TranslateHelper.talkTranslate` (Baidu HTTP). TTS via `playTextSocket`.

### One-key translate (single short audio)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant App
  participant Cloud
  participant BLE as Device 0x26

  User->>App: Press and hold / device button
  App->>App: recording
  User->>App: Release
  App->>Cloud: Chunked PCM upload (speechRecognition)
  Cloud-->>App: ASR → translate → TTS (SSE stream)
  App->>BLE: send original + translation text
  App->>App: Auto-play TTS if enabled
```

- **iOS** `WKAudioOneKeyTranslateManager`: state enum `none → recording → sttSuccess → translateSuccess | errors`; `ruleType = onekeyTranslate`; device path listens for `BLE_RecordType.aiOneKeyTranslate`.
- **Android** `AiOneTransHelper`: device triggers `TYPE_RECORDING_OPERATE` with `type == 0x06`; states `0=start, 1=end, 2=restart, 3=cancel`; streams via `ASRStreamPort`, pushes results over `AiTransOrder` **0x26**.

## API shape

**Base URL**: `{aiHost}gateway/machine/v2/` (Android `DeviceChannel.getUrl()`; iOS `WKAIAPIManager.aiAPIHost`)

### 1) Short audio ASR + translate + TTS (primary for both modes)

```
POST {base}/function/speechRecognition
  ?fromLanguageId={int}
  &toLanguageId={int}
  &transFlag={bool}
  &ttsFlag={bool}
  &mutualTranslationFlag={bool}
Body: application/octet-stream (chunked PCM while recording)
Response: SSE events, JSON per chunk (WKShortAudioStreamRespond / TSTBean)
  dataType: 1=ASR, 2=translate, 3=TTS audio, 4=error
```

### 2) Text-only SSE translate (typed text / fallback)

```
POST {base}/function/transLateStream
Content-Type: application/json
Body: { fromLanguageId, toLanguageId, text, ttsFlag }
Response: SSE (same dataType scheme)
```

Legacy non-SSE (older one-key path):

```
POST {base}/aiatoms/v1/oneClickTranslationFile
Multipart: file + toFrom + toTrans
```

### 3) Language list

```
GET/POST {base}/aiChargeClient/languageList?pageNum=&pageSize=&languageId=
```

### Headers (both platforms)

| Header | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `token` | User auth |
| `Channel-Id` | Channel/flavor |
| `Product-Id` | Device product type |
| `Rule-Content-Type` | Feature rule ID (see below) |
| `Sn-Code`, `Device-Code` | Device identity |
| `Client-Type` | 2 = Android |

**Glasses rule IDs** (`WKAIAPISmartGlassesInterface` / `AiPayCommonUtils`):

| Feature | Rule-Content-Type |
|---|---|
| 同声传译 | 57 (`PROJECT_GLASSES_SI`) |
| 一键翻译 | 58 (`PROJECT_GLASSES_TS`) |
| 面对面翻译 | 59 (`PROJECT_GLASSES_P2P`) |

Default language IDs (CN market): **175 = 中文**, **83 = 英语**.

### WebSocket

Face-to-face and one-key use **HTTP SSE**, not WebSocket. WebSocket is used for **同声传译** (`feature_interpretation` in Flutter).

## BLE commands for glasses / watch display

### One-key translate — domain **0x26** (`AiTransOrder` / `BLE_WAKEUP+AISound`)

| subId | Direction | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `0x01` | device→app | Device requests translate (`kWKAudioRecordingToTranslate`) |
| `0x02` | app→device | Original language name (UTF-8) |
| `0x03` | app→device | Target language name |
| `0x04` | app→device | Translate status (`0`=in progress, `1`=done) |
| `0x05` | app→device | Error (`0` ok, `1` record fail, `2` timeout, `3` translate fail) |
| `0x06` | app→device | Original text (max ~500 chars) |
| `0x07` | app→device | Translation text |
| `0x08` | device→app | Stop TTS playback |

Mic permission nudge: domain **0x27** subId `0x01`.

TTS playback state: domain **0x32** subId `0x03` (`sendTtsPlayState`).

Device recording control: `TYPE_RECORDING_OPERATE` with **type `0x06`** (one-key), states 0–3.

### Legacy watch translate — domain **0x16/0x17** (`TranslateOrder`)

Used by `TranslateDeviceHelper` for Baidu-era watch flow: stream question chars (`0x17/0x01`), stream answer (`0x16/0x04`), language list (`0x16/0x01`), play end (`0x16/0x03`). Triggered by `TYPE_RECORDING_OPERATE` **type `0x01`**.

### Simultaneous interpretation (related, already in Flutter) — domain **0x46**

Not face-to-face/one-key, but pushes final translation to glasses via `sendSimInterText` / `sendSimInterStatus` in `common_glasses_protocol`.

**Face-to-face** is primarily a **phone two-column UI**; it does not use the **0x26** push path in the sources reviewed. One-key is what pushes ASR/translation strings to the device for on-glasses display.

---

## State machines (summary)

| Mode | States | Session model |
|---|---|---|
| Legacy face (`HomeRecordHelper`) | `OFF, RECORDING, CANCEL, CONVERT, FAIL` | Per button press |
| Cloud face (`FaceTransHelper` / iOS F2F VM) | `onRecordStart → ASR → translate → TTS → onTranFinish` | Per utterance; 60s cap |
| One-key iOS | `WKAudioRecordResultType`: `recording, sttSuccess, translating, translateSuccess, sttError, translateError, recordTimeLimite, nobalance…` | Single utterance per press |
| One-key Android (`AiOneTransHelper`) | BLE-driven `operateRecord(0–3)` + `isRecording` + stream port `isWorking` | Device or app initiated |
| Legacy watch (`TranslateDeviceHelper`) | `operateRecord` + char-by-char BLE streaming to watch | Device-initiated single Q&A |

---

## Flutter migration notes

Per inventory, planned target is **`feature_translate`** (or extend `feature_interpretation`). Reuse:

- SSE client pattern from `ASRStreamPort` / `WKShortAudioRecordStreamManager`
- API URLs from `DeviceChannel` / `WKAICommonAPI`
- BLE **0x26** builders from `AiTransOrder` (not yet in `common_glasses_protocol`; only **0x46** sim-inter is)
- Do **not** port legacy Baidu/Ali path unless supporting old watches

`feature-glasses` has **no** translate code; glasses use shared `module-ai` + BLE **0x26**.
